L752 says 'vLLM은 내보낸 블록을 CPU 메모리로 복사합니다' in the present tense. L763 defers the recovery mode to '--help', but the cited Optimization doc (L1273) says V1 defaults to RECOMPUTE rather than SWAP, so a reader may take swap as current behaviour.
